value.marks: Species in a community depend on each other; this is interdependence (1). One species may be the food of another, so that species loses its food supply (1). value.text: Discuss the benefits and the risks of growing genetically modified crops.
value.marks:
Top band (5-6): Balanced discussion of benefits and risks.
GM crops can be made resistant to insect attack or to herbicides (1). GM crops generally give increased yields, so more food is grown on the same land (1). Crops can be given extra nutrients, which helps people whose diet is poor (1). Some people worry about the effect on populations of wild flowers and insects (1). The effects of eating GM crops on human health have not been fully explored (1). Some people object to changing the genes of a living organism (1).
